component.name: Razer BlackShark Linux Fix
component.summary: Initialize the Razer BlackShark V2 Pro 2023 USB dongle on Linux

description.p: Graphical launcher for the Razer BlackShark V2 Pro 2023 (2.4 GHz USB dongle, USB ID 1532:0555) initialization workaround. On affected systems the dongle appears but audio output, microphone, or media controls do not all work after connecting. The app guides you through the tested re-initialization sequence: stop the user's PipeWire/WirePlumber, unplug the dongle, unload snd_usb_audio, reconnect the dongle, press the volume rocker, reload snd_usb_audio, and restart the audio services.

The privileged steps run through a small root-owned helper installed once via pkexec into /usr/local/libexec (writable on immutable systems such as Bazzite). Only USB device 1532:0555 is detected and verified.
Initial Flatpak release with a simple GTK setup UI.
